source: ENDF/B-VIII.0 (D. A. Brown et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 148, 1 (2018)), neutron and neutron fission yield sublibraries from the NNDC archives in data/endf, parsed by libs/constants/scripts/generate-endf.ts: MF3 cross sections in barns above the resolved-resonance boundary (resonances are not reconstructed), MF4 Legendre mean cosine of elastic scattering in the centre of mass, MF1 prompt neutrons per fission, MF5 tabulated prompt fission spectra as 64 quantiles, MF8 independent fission-product yields per incident energy; energies in eV, thinned to 0.5% under linear interpolation up to 20 MeV
